assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic vehicle sprite based on actual documented Korean tow-truck conversions.
Create ONE transparent-background studio photograph of a 2017–2020 SsangYong G4 Rexton four-door tow-truck conversion in PERFECT true SIDE PROFILE facing RIGHT (front at right, rear at left), camera level with wheel hubs and parallel to the side. Reference 1 is the real Korean G4 Rexton tow conversion: copy its practical engineering layout, retained FOUR doors and two-row enclosed cabin, rear passenger/cargo roof cut immediately behind the second-row doors, short shallow rear equipment deck, close-fitting rear fenders and compact folded black steel underlift at the very back. Reference 2 is the official unconverted G4 Rexton side photograph: faithfully preserve its recognizable generation-specific bonnet, front fender, headlamp, front bumper, mirrors, windshield/cabin shape, side door contours and wheelbase, only changing the rear to the documented conversion.
Maintain the passenger-car scale: original 2865mm wheelbase, original body about 4850mm long, towing equipment adds only a short rear projection about 250–350mm. Large cabin but NO extended limousine length. Retain the original front and rear axle positions; exactly TWO visible complete wheels, same realistic size and plausible stock alloy rims, round tires with perfectly level bottoms. The folded underlift is a compact sturdy black bracket close against the rear edge, extending no higher than the roof and no lower than the rocker panel, NOT a long crane and NOT an extra axle. Include realistic small rear vertical tail-light tower and one low amber roof warning lightbar.
Paint the vehicle clean glossy white with tasteful narrow vivid orange high-visibility stripes on the rear equipment panel and rocker, brushed aluminum deck edges, black rubber/steel equipment. No company name, no phone numbers, no license plate text, no people, no background, no cast ground shadow; no toy, cartoon, illustration or plastic render. Photographic metallic reflections, real glass with restrained tint, chrome details and sharp authentic seams. Preserve complete vehicle with generous clear transparent margins on a wide landscape canvas, preferably 1536x768. No front or rear face visible: orthographic-looking true side photograph. Make all equipment mechanically sensible and stowed for driving.

Reproduce only that badge, front-facing and undistorted, not the taxi itself: tall narrow rounded arch plaque approximately width:height 0.68:1, the white Haechi animal centered with tasteful thin dark internal lines. No HAECHI SEOUL words, no extra letters, no numbers, no additional scenery or objects. The navy plaque must be opaque and the surrounding area genuinely transparent.
